title: Open the h-File
setup: Black's king sits on h8 behind three pawns, your rook waits on b4, and the queen is already looking at h7.
hint: The king is safe only while the file in front of it stays shut. Work out what it would cost to open it.
explanation:
## The Idea

The h7 pawn is the only cover, and it is defended solely by the king. {{Qxh7+}} forces {{Kxh7}}, and the rook swings across for {{Rh4#}}. A king that has to recapture steps onto the file you are about to open.
